verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's docs describe a `humanlayer automation run` command that runs one Cloud-visible coding session from a CI job, a cron machine, or a server script. They also document launch tokens for non-interactive shells without a PTY, which together cover the headless CI/CD and scripting core of the story. Missing for 10: details on exit codes, output handling and CI pipeline examples; independent or hands-on corroboration that headless runs work as described.
